name: ask-then-do-it
description: An independent gated AI development workflow from requirement discovery through evidence-based review and architecture diagnosis. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Matt Pocock.

author.name: Ian Wu, Handle by me Tech Studio

interface.shortDescription: Develop software through explicit gates and evidence.
interface.longDescription: A modular workflow for requirement grilling, evidence-backed project knowledge, specification, user-selected TDD or direct implementation, twelve-lens review, and safe architecture diagnosis.
interface.developerName: Ian Wu, Handle by me Tech Studio
defaultPrompt: Use $ask-then-do-it to guide this software change.
Use $ask-with-docs to clarify this change and preserve project knowledge.
Use $implement-direct to implement an approved direct Ticket without behavioral tests.
Use $improve-architecture to diagnose system structure without changing code.
